title: Sliding Window Maximum
description:
A window of size k slides from the left end of an array to the right end, one position at a time. Report the maximum value inside the window at every position.

Input format
Line 1: n and k separated by a space.
Line 2: n integers.

Output format
n-k+1 integers on one line, separated by single spaces: the maximum of each window from left to right.
constraints: 1 <= k <= n <= 100000. Values fit in a 32-bit signed integer.
hints: Recomputing the maximum of each window from scratch takes O(n*k). What information from the previous window can you reuse?
Keep a double-ended queue of indices whose values are in decreasing order. The front is always the index of the current maximum.

For each new element: pop indices from the back while their value is <= the new value, push the new index, and pop the front if it has left the window (index <= i-k). The front is the answer once i >= k-1.

examples.explanation: A single window containing a single value.
